$comment: Derived from the changelog's released sections by the changelog skill (consumer-actions-record.ts); the release step rewrites it, so never edit it by hand.

actions.description: **Breaking:** the copy holds tracked files only. A `ci.log_command` that relied on something installed or generated in the working tree (`node_modules`, build output) no longer finds it, and the copy is not a git checkout, so `git` and `gh` do not find the repository from its working directory.
actions.instruction: Make the command self-contained, or have it install what it needs and give `gh` `-R <owner>/<repo>`; a script that imports only Bun's built-ins and files in the repository needs nothing.

actions.description: `tracker.ts` exits with one code per class: `5` for a spent rate limit, as before, with its `RATE-LIMITED until <time>` line, then `6` unreachable, `7` too costly, `8` server fault, `9` unauthorized, `10` not found and `11` invalid, the class named at the start of the error line. A failure no call to the tracker caused still exits `1`. [do-item's tracker operations](plugin/skills/do-item/SKILL.md#tracker-operations) list them.
actions.instruction: A runbook or script that reads `tracker.ts`'s exit `1` as every failure reads `6` to `11` as failures too.

actions.description: **Codex: the turn-budget hook is registered by `jig upgrade`, not shipped by the plugin.** Codex re-reviews a plugin's hooks whenever any file of the plugin changes, and skips them until it is approved again. The Codex plugin now ships none. `jig upgrade` adds one `PreToolUse` entry to `$CODEX_HOME/hooks.json` (`~/.codex` by default) whose command never changes and runs the installed plugin copy's guard, so approving it once with `/hooks` stands across releases. After this release, approve the guard once in each Codex home; until then it does not run there. Run `jig upgrade --codex` with `CODEX_HOME` set to give another home the entry. `jig uninstall --machine --yes` removes it. Claude Code is unchanged.
actions.instruction: Run `jig upgrade --codex` and approve the guard with `/hooks` in every Codex home that runs unattended passes.
